description: Melt value of a silver item (sterling flatware, tea set, jewellery, bar, round, scrap) from its weight, unit and fineness at the live silver spot price, in any currency. Optional dealer_spread_percent returns the likely buyer offer. Sterling means at least 925/1000 silver under 16 CFR 23.5. Default fineness is sterling.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code, for example USD, EUR, GBP, INR, CAD, AUD, MXN. Default USD.

dealer_spread_percent.description: Percent a buyer keeps below melt, for example 15 for an offer at 85% of melt. Default 0.

fineness.description: Silver grade: "fine" (999), "britannia" (958.4), "sterling" (925), "coin" (900), "800", or parts per thousand such as 925, or a fraction such as 0.925.

unit.description: Weight unit: gram, kilogram, troy_ounce, pennyweight, grain, avoirdupois_ounce, pound, troy_pound, tola. Aliases such as g, kg, oz, ozt, dwt, lb work. "oz" means troy ounce; use avoirdupois_ounce for a kitchen scale.

weight.description: Weight of the item, for example 250.

name: calculate_silver_value
title: Calculate silver melt value
